description: The Luminous Eco Watt Neo 1050 is a home UPS/inverter delivering pure sine wave output for sensitive electronics. Supports 1 TV + 3 fans + 1 tube light simultaneously. Features intelligent battery management for extended battery life. MCB protection included.
price_reasoning: Luminous official ₹5,499 Amazon ₹5,199 (sale price may change) Flipkart ₹5,350. Chose MRP.
manufacturer_info: Luminous Power Technologies (Schneider Electric subsidiary) India's #1 home UPS brand with 28% market share. 7 manufacturing plants.
pros: Pure sine wave safe for all electronics
cons: LED indicators not as informative as LCD
